thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx + provisioning errors for inference fleet in europe-west1 (eu-west-1). Autoscaler failed to add GPU nodes; downstream 503s for long-context workloads. Pager: mike_oncall

mike_oncall: Ack — I'm oncall and looking. Initial check: control-plane shows repeated ProvisioningFailed for pool-gpu-eu. Marking high customer impact and escalating to infra.

sara_sre: seeing p95 token latency spike ~2.4s and 5xx rate ~6% for the last 6m. Autoscaler logs: `quotaExceeded` and `quota: GPUs per project`.

alex_infra: Confirmed. Cloud provider quota was hit during the autoscaler surge window, causing instances to fail provisioning. I'm spinning up a manual reserved pool and requesting project quota bump.

josh_prodeng: Quick mitigation plan: 1) Route a portion of inference traffic to us-west to buy time, 2) manually increase reserved GPU pool in eu for hot spare, 3) kick off quota increase request with cloud support, 4) schedule post-incident review.

sara_sre: I'll shift 15% of traffic to us-west and kick manual resize. Command I'm running now: ```gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize gpu-eu-mig --region=europe-west1 --size=18```

mike_oncall: Doing live routing change: `redwood-router update-route --service=inference-prod --region=europe-west1 --split=85:15(us-west)` — pushing now.

deploy-bot: Provision request accepted. New instances queued: gpu-eu-987, gpu-eu-988, gpu-eu-989. Boot logs streaming.

irene_support: Notifying affected customers. Early triage: 3 customers reported 503s (acme-corp, fastshop, medai) and ~5 customers reported degraded latency. Escalated to their account reps.

alex_infra: Cloud support case opened: https://cloudsupport.example/cases/CS-44321 — requesting expedited GPU quota increase. ETA unclear. As backup, I increased the per-region maxNodes for the autoscaler and added a short-term exception to allow extra preemptible capacity.

sara_sre: 5xxs are down to ~0.8% after routing + manual pool increase. Latency trending down. Keeping monitoring for 30m.

mike_oncall: Good work. We're in mitigation state. No data leak, only availability impact. Recording timeline and commands in the incident doc.

josh_prodeng: Post-incident follow-up: create postmortem, capture root cause (quota + autoscaler hard-fail), and list remediation actions (quota monitoring, autoscaler retries, regional failover test). I'll own scheduling the postmortem. Proposed: tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

sara_sre: Creating ticket now: INF-8721 (incident writeup + remediation tracker) — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8721

mike_oncall: Adding initial action items inline here to track before the postmortem: 1) Investigate autoscaler failure modes when quota errors returned (owner: alex_infra, due: 2026-03-20, ticket: INF-8725). 2) Add alert for projected GPU quota exhaustion + automated soft-fail routing (owner: sara_sre, due: 2026-03-16, ticket: INF-8726). 3) Run a regional failover tabletop and an automated chaos test that simulates quota loss (owner: josh_prodeng, due: 2026-04-01, ticket: INF-8730). 4) Support/customer comms post: prepare templated message and outreach log (owner: irene_support, due: 2026-03-15, ticket: INF-8727).

irene_support: Draft message for customers in thread: "We're investigating increased errors in eu-west-1; mitigation in progress by routing traffic and adding capacity. We'll follow up with timelines and remediation steps." I'll ping account reps after the postmortem is scheduled.

alex_infra: Quick note: autoscaler currently treats quota errors as terminal. Proposal: change to backoff + retry with exponential jitter and fall back to pre-provisioned spare pool. I'll attach a config PR to INF-8725.

deploy-bot: Hotfix applied to autoscaler config (temporary): `autoscaler.maxNodes=40 -> 60` and `autoscaler.quotaRetry=true` (rollout id: ro-20260315-01).

sara_sre: Verified rollback safety and ran smoke tests. No regressions observed. 5xx baseline restored. Marking mitigation successful. :white_check_mark:

mike_oncall: Scheduling postmortem meeting for 2026-03-16 14:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent to SRE, Infra, ProdEng, Support. Please add others if needed.

josh_prodeng: I'll prepare a short RCA deck and a suggested timeline for the postmortem.

mike_oncall: Final checklist before we close this incident thread: - Confirm INF-8721 has initial timeline + logs (done), - Ensure owners are assigned (done), - Confirm customer outreach (irene_support to send after we sync).

irene_support: I'll send the customer note after the postmortem and log messages in the ticket.

mike_oncall: Closing incident alert channel. Follow-ups are tracked in INF-8721 and child tickets INF-8725, INF-8726, INF-8730, INF-8727. Thanks everyone for the quick responses. :pray:

sara_sre: (reacted with :eyes:)

alex_infra: will upload autoscaler logs and timeline to INF-8725 by EOD.

josh_prodeng: reminder: add a postmortem action to run quota capacity exercise as part of onboarding for prod-eng.

mike_oncall: Thread locked for new messages — please comment on the Jira ticket for follow-ups."
